_comment: R084 TASK 0 licence gate, machine-readable. The ruling and its evidence are docs/licences/PROVIDER_GATE_2026-08-22.md. generate.py REFUSES any provider not marked CLEARED, so the gate is enforced by the code rather than by whoever remembers it. Changing a mark here without a Fable ruling is the violation. AMENDED 2026-08-24 (R099): the openai mark moved BARRED to CLEARED on the owner's written brief, carrying OpenAI support Ticket 456254; the clearance is SCOPED to development-stage artwork generation and the conditions are in that entry's scope field. The R084 assessment below is unchanged for stability and remains the basis for the gate's existence.

stability.reason: No gambling restriction in the API Terms of Service or the Acceptable Use Policy, verified with working controls. The API terms carry neither the Community License's 'Powered by Stability AI' attribution nor its USD 1,000,000 revenue termination clause.

openai.reason: CLEARED for development-stage artwork generation ONLY, per OpenAI support Ticket 456254 (received 2026-08-24), which confirms that ChatGPT image generation (gpt-image-1) may be used to create visual art assets for incorporation into real-money slot machine games published on licensed gambling platforms. Supersedes the R084 BARRED mark for that scope only. The permission is stated to be subject to the current Usage Policies and Terms of Use. The full record, including the provenance of the ruling and the R084 contractual chain it addresses, is docs/legal/openai-ticket-456254-ruling.md.

scope.permitted: Development-stage visual art assets only: symbols, backgrounds and other artwork, for incorporation into the game.
scope.subject_to: the current OpenAI Usage Policies and Terms of Use
scope.note: Do not broaden this clearance beyond the ticket. Any use outside 'permitted' is outside the ruling and outside this mark.

superseded_assessment.reason: The Usage Policies effective 2026-10-29 prohibit 'real money gambling' under 'you cannot use our services for'. The Services Agreement incorporates those policies by reference (16.1), restricts use that violates them (3.3a), carves a breach of 3.3 out of the liability cap (14.1) and indemnifies OpenAI for it (13.2). Future Spinner is a real-money gambling product.
superseded_assessment.note: Kept rather than deleted: the record of what was believed, and why, is evidence. See docs/legal/openai-ticket-456254-ruling.md section 5.
